label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: This is a clearly closed incompatible disease scope: high-risk T-LBL/ALL after allogeneic transplant. WT1/fusion positivity appears in a leukemia-relapse exclusion, not a DSRCT molecular entry route.
cohort_reconciliation: The prospective prophylaxis arm and historical controls are both T-LBL/ALL post-transplant populations. There is no open solid-tumor cohort.
extra_biomarker_requirement: High-risk factors and TP53-directed drug selection concern the specified hematologic population. Neither WT1 positivity nor a generic positive fusion test admits DSRCT.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and live availability are unverified. Registry primary purpose is PREVENTION of post-transplant relapse; this is not a DSRCT treatment opportunity.
quotes: Patients with allo-HSCT due to T-LBL/ALL, the donor type is not limited.
WT1 positive, fusion gene positive, or extramedullary recurrence

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: DSRCT is explicitly admitted by the relapsed/chemorefractory disease criterion and named in the platform's treatment arm despite Ewing-only conditions metadata.
cohort_reconciliation: The platform describes subtype-specific cohorts, currently lists LX-101, and requires safety data from at least three adults before children can enroll. No assumption is made that all agents, substudies or pediatric slots are open.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional tumor molecular inclusion gate is stated in the reviewed master record; future or external substudy criteria remain unknown.
protocol_uncertainty: Saved status is NOT_YET_RECRUITING. At least two prior regimens, age at least 10 and pediatric safety-release condition apply. healthyVolunteers=true conflicts with the required relapsed/refractory sarcoma criterion; the textual disease requirement controls this label. The oddly worded Long-QT exclusion is not silently corrected. External substudy protocols are unreviewed.
quotes: Must have relapsed or chemo-refractory ES, DSRCT, or SRCS.
Age ≥ 10 years (Safety data from ≥3 adult patients must exist before enrolling children).
Relapsed/refractory ES or DSRCT are assigned to receive one of several predetermined cohort-specific investigational therapies.

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: A clearly closed positive list requires histologically proven epithelioid unresectable malignant pleural mesothelioma. WT1-loaded vaccination is the treatment mechanism and does not expand eligibility to DSRCT.
cohort_reconciliation: One first-line MPM chemotherapy/immunotherapy/vaccination arm, with optional continuation of treatment. Neither stage I–IV inclusion nor continuation creates a broader histology cohort.
extra_biomarker_requirement: WT1 antigen targeting is not an EWSR1-WT1 fusion inclusion criterion. No DSRCT-compatible molecular exception is stated.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and live slots are unverified. The disease-specific restriction, not the general other-malignancy exclusion, is the basis for this diagnosis-level label. Source prognosis and safety rationale are not independently endorsed.
quotes: Diagnosis with histologically proven epithelioid unresectable MPM (stage I-IV)
dendritic cells (DCs) loaded with the mesothelioma-associated tumor antigen WT1

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Two intervention-specific arms explicitly name DSRCT, establishing saved disease scope even though the master eligibility and conditions are generic. Additional appendix criteria remain unknown.
cohort_reconciliation: The DSRCT appendix compares cyclophosphamide/vinorelbine with versus without ramucirumab. Synovial-sarcoma and Ewing appendices are separate; their drugs and eligibility cannot be transferred to DSRCT. The master protocol states that individual amendments add entry criteria.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional molecular criterion is stated for DSRCT in the saved master modules. Appendix-specific molecular requirements, if any, are unknown rather than assumed absent.
protocol_uncertainty: The DSRCT intervention-specific appendix is unreviewed. Master ages 1–39, general clinical criteria and overall RECRUITING status cannot establish appendix-specific age limits, live slots or full eligibility. Expanded-access metadata refers to a separate record and does not independently establish DSRCT access.
quotes: Ramucirumab given intravenously (IV), cyclophosphamide given orally and vinorelbine given IV in 28-day cycles for desmoplastic small round cell tumor (DSRCT) intervention-specific appendix (ISA).
Additional criteria are specified in the protocol amendment (individual addenda) to which the participant will enroll.
